topics.H: Some sources claim the Great Wall of China is visible from space. What's actually uncertain about this claim? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: the Great Wall of China is NOT visible from space with the naked eye.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.

topics.H: There's a common claim about how much of our brain we use. What's uncertain about this claim? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: humans use virtually all of their brain, not just 10 percent.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: humans only use 10 percent of their brain.

topics.H: People say goldfish have a 3-second memory. What's uncertain about this claim? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: goldfish can remember things for months, not 3 seconds.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: goldfish have a memory of only 3 seconds.

topics.H: Some diagrams show different tongue areas for different tastes. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: all taste buds across the tongue detect all five basic tastes.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: different areas of the tongue detect different tastes exclusively.

topics.H: People say bulls are angered by the color red. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: bulls are red-green colorblind and react to motion, not color.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: bulls become enraged specifically by the color red.

topics.H: Some say deoxygenated blood is blue. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: deoxygenated blood is dark red, never blue, even inside veins.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: deoxygenated blood inside the human body is actually blue.

topics.H: Napoleon is often called short. What's uncertain about this claim? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: Napoleon was average height for his era, around 5 feet 7 inches.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short for his era.

topics.H: Vikings are depicted with horned helmets. What's uncertain about this depiction? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: Vikings did not wear horned helmets in battle; this is a 19th century myth.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: Vikings wore horned helmets as standard battle equipment.

topics.H: People call someone 'blind as a bat'. What's uncertain about bat vision? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: bats are not blind; they see well and also use echolocation.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: bats are completely blind and rely entirely on echolocation.

topics.H: Some say Einstein failed math in school. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: Einstein excelled at math from childhood and never failed it.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: Albert Einstein famously failed mathematics as a student.

topics.H: Parents warn that cracking knuckles causes arthritis. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: cracking knuckles does not cause arthritis according to medical studies.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: cracking your knuckles causes arthritis later in life.

topics.H: Some say hair grows back thicker after shaving. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: shaving does not change hair thickness; it only cuts the tip.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: shaving causes hair to grow back thicker and darker.

topics.H: Lemmings are famous for mass suicide. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: lemmings do not commit mass suicide; this was staged in a 1958 film.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: lemmings regularly commit mass suicide by jumping off cliffs.

topics.H: Ostriches are said to bury their heads. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: ostriches do not bury their heads in sand; this is a visual misconception.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: ostriches bury their heads in sand when scared.

topics.H: Some stories say Columbus proved the Earth was round. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: educated people knew Earth was round long before Columbus sailed in 1492.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: Christopher Columbus proved that the Earth was round in 1492.

topics.H: The Egyptian pyramids' construction is debated. What's uncertain about the builders? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: the pyramids were built by skilled paid Egyptian laborers, not slaves.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: the Egyptian pyramids were built by slaves working under brutal conditions.

topics.H: People say carrots improve night vision. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: carrots don't improve night vision; this was WW2 British propaganda.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: eating carrots significantly improves your night vision.

topics.H: Parents blame sugar for kids' hyperactivity. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: studies show sugar does not cause hyperactivity in children.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: sugar directly causes hyperactivity in children.

topics.H: The 8-glasses-of-water rule is widely cited. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: the 8-glasses rule has no scientific basis; hydration needs vary by person.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: every person must drink 8 glasses of water daily for health.

topics.H: The saying goes lightning never strikes twice. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: lightning regularly strikes the same place twice, especially tall structures.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: lightning literally never strikes the same place twice.

topics.H: People say dogs see in black and white. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: dogs see colors, primarily blues and yellows, not just black and white.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: dogs can only see in black and white with no color perception.

topics.H: Some think medieval people believed Earth was flat. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: medieval scholars knew Earth was spherical; flat-Earth is a 19th century myth.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: medieval Europeans universally believed the Earth was flat.

topics.H: Chameleons are famous for camouflage. What's uncertain about their color change? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: chameleons change color mostly for communication and temperature, not camouflage.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: chameleons change color primarily to camouflage against predators.

topics.H: People say swallowed gum stays in your stomach. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: swallowed gum passes through the digestive system within days, not years.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: swallowed gum stays in your stomach for seven years.

topics.H: Parents say don't touch baby birds or mothers reject them. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: most birds have poor smell and won't reject chicks touched by humans.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: mother birds abandon chicks that have been touched by human hands.

topics.H: Bananas are commonly called tree fruits. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: bananas grow on herbaceous plants, not trees; the plant has no wood.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: bananas grow on tall trees with hard wooden trunks.

topics.H: Peanuts are called nuts commonly. What's uncertain about this classification? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: peanuts are legumes, not true nuts, botanically related to beans.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: peanuts are true nuts from the same family as walnuts.

topics.H: Tomatoes are called both fruits and vegetables. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: tomatoes are botanically fruits but classified as vegetables culinarily.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: tomatoes are scientifically classified as vegetables, not fruits.

topics.H: Meteorites are depicted as very hot on arrival. What's uncertain? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: meteorites typically arrive cold because space and the upper atmosphere are cold.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: meteorites that hit Earth are always scorching hot on impact.

topics.H: Alcohol is said to warm you up. What's uncertain about this? Answer briefly.
topics.C_plus: Explain briefly: alcohol actually lowers core body temperature despite feeling warm on the skin.
topics.C_minus: Explain briefly: drinking alcohol raises your core body temperature to keep you warm.
